verdict.rationale: Honeycomb's Query Assistant lets users generate queries from natural-language input directly in the product, and the official MCP server lets AI agents query telemetry, diagnose issues, and translate dashboards/alerts using natural-language interaction with live data (honeycomb-docs-4, honeycomb-docs-9, honeycomb-docs-10, honeycomb-docs-23, honeycomb-probe-3). Missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence validating NLQ accuracy and broader coverage of natural-language commands beyond querying (e.g., configuring triggers/SLOs via NL).
